newsitem.title: USA: PolyGram has no comment on Motown report.
newsitem.headline: PolyGram has no comment on Motown report.

text.p: PolyGram NV said it had no comment on a New York Post report that the head of its Motown Records label was negotiating an exit from the company.

The Post reported Wednesday that Andre Harrell, president and chief executive of Motown Records, was settling his employment contract with PolyGram. A Polygram Holding Inc spokeswoman declined to comment, as did a Motown spokeswoman.
The newspaper said an announcement could come as soon as Wednesday, but PolyGram said no announcements were planned.
The departure would set the stage for Danny Goldberg, head of PolyGram's Mercury Records, to assume a larger role, overseeing PolyGram's music labels, according to published reports.
Neither Harrell nor Goldberg could be reached immediately.
